### `eye_foil_deep`

How far can the SURFACE go? Faces near-opaque, seams tight and hot — maximum 'light from underneath' before the picture turns to lace.

### `eye_foil_wide`

Can COLOUR carry the layering instead of brightness? Half as many, twice as broad foil bands, and a big depth shift so sclera, iris and pupil separate by hue.

<p>

</p>
